sources.title: openadmet/5ht2-chemeleon-baseline · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: In this repo, we have our baseline model for 5-HT2 receptor agonism. It is a multitask CheMeleon model trained on pEC50 data curated from ChEMBL for the following targets: 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C.
